title: pandanus pulposus
intro: Pandanus pulposus, commonly known as the Sea Pandan or Pandan, is a type of plant that belongs to the family Pandanaceae. This plant is rich in nutrients and has been traditionally used in Southeast Asian countries to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Pandanus pulposus include its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial and antioxidant properties. The bioactive constituents of Pandanus pulposus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antidiabetic effects.
